summary: Independent review of Jinshu 109 part 7/13 reaudit-3 (attachment SHA-256 verified). I read all nine owned units (s0256–s0261, s0079–s0081). They state no birth, death or age, and s0260/s0261 give only relative time (自頃迄今, 卒歲), so no chronology is omitted. All 19 owned items and 6 owned people are supported. The Goguryeo campaign (337–341) and the heir's homage (338–342) are honest envelopes over checked witnesses: Tongjian 339, Samguk Gogugwon 9/10 = 339/340, Haedong 咸康三年 with 明年, and Jinshu's relative 其年/明年 after the 340/341 recognition episode. No single year is chosen, and the claims' statement that Tongjian has no 340 homage entry is accurate. The recognition memorial (340–341) runs from Yu Liang's 340 death to Tongjian's 341 grant. Dou Wu and He Jin are correctly marked retrospective-reference with empty hints. The former emperor's grant is correctly bounded on or before 325. Cosmetic issue only: claims 603/605's event text runs together as 'bound325follows'. English review: the en fields of the owned units were read and no definite omission or mistranslation was found, so there is no supplement. This packet has no literal-translation field, so literal is UNCHECKED. This is not a full-chapter or publication approval.

itemChecks.reason: Jinshu s0080 dates the campaign only 其年 after the 340/341 recognition episode. Tongjian puts it in 咸康五年 (339), Samguk Sagi in Gogugwon 9 (339), and Haedong Yoksa in 咸康三年 (337) with the note 通鑑作五年. 337–341 covers these witnesses and Jinshu's possible 340/341 alignments without picking one year.
